title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #7

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Whom did the Prophet kiss when a man said he had never kissed his ten children? (1 mark)
   A. His grandson Al-Hasan
   B. Abu Bakr
   C. Ali as an adult
   D. A stranger

2. When is the last tashahhud recited? (1 mark)
   A. In the final sitting
   B. In the first rak'ah
   C. In ruku
   D. In sujud

3. Which prophet is remembered for generosity to guests? (1 mark)
   A. Yunus
   B. Nuh
   C. Salih
   D. Ibrahim

4. Why are children called an amanah? (1 mark)
   A. They are a trust from Allah
   B. They are strangers
   C. They are servants
   D. They are property

5. What is planting a tree from which animals or people eat counted as? (1 mark)
   A. A waste
   B. Charity for the planter
   C. Nothing
   D. A sin

6. What do we recite after wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. Surah Al-Masad
   C. The testimony of faith
   D. Nothing

7. Which of these is honest work? (1 mark)
   A. Farming
   B. Cheating
   C. Gambling
   D. Stealing

8. "Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin" means (1 mark)
   A. I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
   B. Allah is the greatest
   C. Say: He is Allah, the One
   D. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds

9. What did the Prophet say about dua? (1 mark)
   A. It is not needed
   B. It is only for old people
   C. It is worship
   D. It is a game

10. What is a buibui? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A black cover worn by women along the coast
   C. A drink
   D. A cap

11. What should we say when dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Nothing
   C. Amin
   D. Bismillah

12. What is wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. A journey
   B. Washing certain body parts with water before prayer
   C. Giving zakat
   D. Reciting the Qur'an

13. Which of these is a good time to use the siwak? (1 mark)
   A. Before wudhu and prayer
   B. Never
   C. Only at weddings
   D. Only in winter

14. Which verse tells us to fear Allah and respect family ties? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 4:1
   B. Qur'an 110:3
   C. Qur'an 1:2
   D. Qur'an 112:1

15. Which of these is internet media? (1 mark)
   A. A video website
   B. A poster
   C. A newspaper
   D. A book

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe three good manners of eating apart from saying Bismillah. (3 marks)

17. State three groups of people who deserve help. (3 marks)

18. Give the meanings of shangazi, mjomba and binamu. (3 marks)

19. Suggest three honest ways of earning a living. (3 marks)

20. Explain the difference between patience and revenge with a school example. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — His grandson Al-Hasan
   The Prophet said whoever shows no mercy will not be shown mercy.

2. A — In the final sitting
   In the last sitting.

3. D — Ibrahim
   He served his guests a fattened calf.

4. A — They are a trust from Allah
   Parents must care for them.

5. B — Charity for the planter
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

6. C — The testimony of faith
   Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah...

7. A — Farming
   Honest work is farming.

8. D — All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds
   This is the second verse of Al-Fatiha.

9. C — It is worship
   Recorded by Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi.

10. B — A black cover worn by women along the coast
   A buibui is a cover.

11. D — Bismillah
   Say Bismillah for good acts.

12. B — Washing certain body parts with water before prayer
   Wudhu is ablution.

13. A — Before wudhu and prayer
   The Prophet encouraged it before prayers.

14. A — Qur'an 4:1
   Surah An-Nisa 4:1.

15. A — A video website
   The internet carries websites and videos.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands before, eat with the right hand, eat from in front, do not criticise food, do not waste.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each manner.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: People in debt, people who lost property through disaster, and the destitute.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Shangazi: father's sister; mjomba: mother's brother; binamu: cousin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Farming, trading in a kiosk, tailoring, carpentry, teaching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Patience is staying calm and trusting Allah, while revenge is hurting back. If a classmate teases you, you stay calm and tell a teacher instead of fighting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for patience, 1 mark for revenge, 1 mark for example.
